chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The one who opens his day by publicizing our secrets, Allah will cause him to be overcome by the heat of the iron and the constriction of the prisons.

key_terms.حَرَّ الْحَدِيدِ: heat of the iron (referring to confinement in iron)

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of publicizing the secrets of the Imams according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) linking the specific sin of exposing the 'secrets' (asrar) of the Imams to divine retribution in the form of 'heat of iron' and 'tightness of prisons.' This serves as a warning against the premature or improper disclosure of esoteric teachings or political realities, ensuring the preservation of the Imamate's authority and the integrity of its guidance until the appropriate time.
